spans.text: The nephilim exist all across Somnus Domina, but the largest concentration of nephilim is their city in the Cauldron, which is populated with several thousand of them. This is considered the holy land for nephilim, and many seek it out during their lifetime or wish to return to the Abiding Heart from the grand temple there.
Nephilim are born with natural combat abilities, as these skills are freely passed on by the Abiding Heart to ensure they are safe and secure while performing their duties.

“It’s so wonderful that the nephilim are becoming more common! They’re wonderful people with so much to teach us but also such a genuine desire to learn! A nephilim is the living embodiment of the need to experience, love, learn, and grow. I would love someday to fill one’s head with every story I know so that their ‘Abiding Heart’ will forever remember Lyre Costilla Chandonnet!

... Do you think a Lyre nephilim might be born one day if I did that?”
